big_case.notes: How the capable-of-repetition-yet-evading-review mootness exception applies to statutory 90-day PLRA preliminary injunctions (and whether 'evading review' looks to plenary Supreme Court review or expedited circuit review) has real institutional importance for prison-conditions litigation in the Fifth Circuit, reflected in the 11-6 en banc vote below. However, the district court's prior entry of final judgment in petitioners' favor after a bench trial independently superseded the expired preliminary injunctions, rendering the case a poor vehicle that the Court cleanly denied without dissent.
